Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - S.C.C. No. 995/2024

Dear Mr. Bose,

Thank you for meeting us on 12/02/2025 about your dispute with M/s Emerald Enterprises. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction. The matter is listed before the Judicial Magistrate First Class Court at Pune.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
